name: Sidereal-Erg

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: They dwell in pressure-keeps beneath the ice, mining heat from the mantle seams.

description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against tidally locked hemisphere, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Settlement lights trace the coastlines and river-veins, visible from high orbit.

The terrain around starship crash site (warship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
